name: BASiC Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: BASiC Semiconductor Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells silicon carbide power semiconductor devices in China and Hong Kong. The company offers products, such as SiC Schottky diodes, SiC MOSFETs, industrial and automotive full-SiC power modules, hybrid SiC discrete devices, gate driver ICs, power management ICs, and provides die and wafer services. Its products are used in renewable power generation, electric vehicles, locomotive traction, industrial drives, and smart grids. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
